request.recipient: 2026 Treasury Reserve Smart Contract stake address stake1784sdxt6jjennmstphgdu7l7c2scf5d02a6cve2dgn5s2kq5u3j9v
request.what: Treasury withdrawal to fund Oura by TxPipe maintenance and enhancement for 12 months, submitted by Intersect on behalf of the vendor.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 540,750 ADA total, comprising 525,000 ADA for Oura maintenance and enhancement and a 15,750 ADA Intersect Budget Administration fee.
The motivation section states the core vendor request as 420,000 ADA plus a 105,000 ADA contingency reserve to fund a part-time maintainer for Oura over 12 months at an annual rate of $105,000 USD.

Oura is described as a Rust-native Cardano event pipeline tool supporting multiple node/data sources and many pluggable output sinks for indexing, monitoring, analytics, and real-time event processing.
The proposal says Oura has 654 commits, 288 stars, 79 forks, and 58 contributors, and points to the public GitHub repository for verification.
The proposer asserts Oura is used across the ecosystem for indexing, monitoring, analytics, and real-time event processing.
The proposal states Oura was previously funded twice through Project Catalyst in Funds 9 and 13 for feature development.
The proposal states TxPipe has received funding through 30 Project Catalyst proposals from Funds 9 through 14, with 26 successfully delivered and 4 currently under development and on schedule.
The proposal states it achieved the required 67% support threshold in the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase and provides references to voting and audited-results materials.
The proposal states the requested amount does not breach the applicable 350M ADA Net Change Limit for Epoch 613 to Epoch 713 at submission.

The proposal describes treasury management through Sundae Labs smart contracts with named TRSC and PSSC addresses, multi-party authorization rules, oversight entities, and a public dashboard for auditability.

summary: The document requests 540,750 ADA for 12 months of Oura maintenance via Intersect-administered treasury smart contracts, with claims centered on open-source infrastructure maintenance, prior TxPipe delivery history, Intersect budget-process approval, NCL compliance, and oversight controls.
